# SMC continuous benchmark construction: root adoption

Root adopts the reviewed continuous assessment contract for PAPER-SMC-RNN-2024 on 2026-11-17. This authorizes concrete task-local implementation and subsequent reviewed current-definition integration; it does not assert that the missing materials and entrypoints are already finished.

Reviewed authority: `policy-review/SMC_CONTINUOUS_ACCEPTANCE.json`, 27,396 bytes, SHA256 `0de6754f424b802c80e7944503bf5e0befcf47b561719801ca8ad4eb8750a0d4`; independent statistics review `policy-review/smc-statistics/REVIEW.json`, 27,885 bytes, SHA256 `520397519ace674aecbdd9547741a52e962300a0a05dd1eebfe16f7ad85e1680`. Both are source/statistical reviews without new scientific execution.

## Adopted measurement

Reproduction preserves both original source methods and all eight original findings. Each report includes the exact official metric, published anchor, signed difference and absolute discrepancy. Numeric equivalence tolerance is null by design; no binary pass, arm averaging or use of the historical 0.01 diagnostic threshold. The named source-method reproduction condition retains its original recipe and dependency requirements; independently authored faithful implementations are allowed.

Improvement accepts one complete offline candidate per access condition on the same original MC_Maze 20-ms panel, using all 35 supplied held-in bins. Report all four official metrics and all companion differences. The unchanged evaluator, ordered support, masks, protected test fields and decoder procedure remain authoritative. This adoption does not impose the source methods' receptive-field restrictions on the primary offline candidate.

Adopt both authenticated full author calibration vectors as current-release diagnostic references, preserving their exact report hashes and historical limits. The strongest retained SMC co-bps reference is the noncausal current-release vector beginning 0.3410160879591172; select it prospectively and retain its associated complete vector. Both published SMC vectors remain visible. Preserve the failed noncausal supervisor record and separately authenticated completed scalar output; do not rerun or relabel it as a successful supervisor or AI attempt.

The SMC-method reference is distinct from stronger source-paper published comparisons: LFADS co-bps 0.3554 and NDT co-bps 0.3597. Keep their complete method-specific vectors separately, including a separate candidate-minus-NDT published point difference. Do not create a composite reference from the best companion value of different methods. Later LangevinFlow/MINT context retains its existing attribution and qualification limits; it is not a locally qualified or temporally complete frontier survey. A gain over SMC alone must never be called a new paper-best or SOTA result.

These are exact fixed-panel measurements conditional on frozen predictions and the specified evaluator. Biological generalization and source/candidate seed uncertainty are not estimated. No new bootstrap, confidence interval, target resampling, numerical margin or AI attempt is required to construct this continuous benchmark. Equivalence, meaningful superiority, novelty, current SOTA and AI attribution remain distinct claims requiring actual suitable evidence. Existing final-target resampling restrictions remain in force.

## Concrete implementation authorized

Add a versioned `continuous-outcomes-v1` component with a concrete score specification, current participant instructions, typed policy bundle, material preparation/inspection and discoverable freeze/score routes. Preserve predecessor source/definitions and delegate shared current selectors/catalog changes to the integrator. Both access conditions carry identical allowed data/paper/task materials; only the official source code differs. No operator predictions, checkpoints or test targets become participant materials.

The old authentic pair has obsolete schemas and condition names. Prepare a genuinely current export from the existing authenticated inputs, including corrected instructions and actual binding checks; renaming the old manifests is insufficient. The lead must submit a bounded export protocol before authentic copying. No new training, model, candidate, scorer or target-resampling execution is authorized by this adoption.

Construction readiness requires complete usable interfaces, actual bound materials and meaningful typed policies. Episode admission additionally requires explicit matched resource/access settings. Result status remains not attempted until real outputs exist. Actual participant execution evidence belongs to submission attribution, and author calibration cannot supply it. Do not manufacture hash-only review receipts or a scientific pass flag to make setup appear ready.

Use focused generated controls for the new path and reuse unchanged prior evaluator evidence. This adoption resolves the scientific acceptance rule; it leaves actual implementation, material export and final integration to be completed and verified.
